routing.note: Dispatch request only; runtime metadata not introspectable. No model-switch claim.

verdictJa: 固定hashの静的intake候補範囲は合格。修正必須指摘なし。実行・隔離・権利真正性・本番release・交換の受入ではない。
verifiedBoundaries: Manifest uses strict field sets/schema/sourceKind/file-set, positive safe integers, bounded arrays and known capability declarations. Unknown metadata cannot add shell/root/network/Wallet powers.

Host registry grant must uniquely bind grantId/owner/author/game/revision/package/license/exact-expiry, current expiry and revoked===false; all assets use bound license. This verifies trusted-host correspondence, not authenticity of a self-supplied registry or legal ownership.

Locally supplied package bytes hash and observed file count/bytes match declarations and ceilings. Every asset binds exact case path/bytes/hash. Canonical sorted file index recomputed from assets must match granted package digest, rejecting substituted content even if its asset hash updated.

Path grammar rejects traversal/absolute/URL/drive/backslash/encoding/shell strings; duplicate case-folded asset IDs/paths and observed file paths refused. Integer overflow refused; expanded sum safe-integer checked.

Engine/runtime exact version pair must match one of two fixed diagnostic adapters; unknown versions yield unsupported, not a runnable generic fallback. Host target runtime/capability and resource ceilings checked.

Particle save format/version/rule reused from existing sandbox; provided save metadata binds owner/game/revision/format/version/rule. No save migration, arbitrary save loading, engine launch or file write in intake.

Diagnostic launch_candidate remains static-local with isolation/launch/input/save all unverified and measured adoption timings null. No capability/approval is minted. Existing sandbox/launch/sample paths remain byte-identical.

existingSuite.scope: Independent rerun. Includes existing synthetic sandbox math/save and process-restart fixture; not a deployed engine isolation or real game acceptance.

additionalProbes.fixtureRecipe: Read fixed tests/game-intake.test.mjs prefix before const diagnose; replace relative lib imports with absolute file URLs and import.meta.url with original test URL; export fixture via data URL. Import fixed diagnoseGameIntake. Assert status, input immutability and all four checks unverified per case. No persistent test/source modifications.
additionalProbes.networkTripwire: Temporarily replace global fetch with throwing/counting function during probes; calls=0; restore afterwards. Static source also has no network/process/write/engine execution APIs.

validation.fullVerify: not run; fixed integration candidate remains parent responsibility

remainingConditions: Real authenticated consumer must resolve current registry grant and target revision; no browser/game-provided context as authority. Diagnosis never proves legal permission or verifies publisher signature.
Consumer must rebind same manifest/package/capability approval and current rights at handoff/execution; revocation or package change after diagnosis cannot reuse stale candidate boolean.

Actual OS process/UID/network/resource isolation, launch/input/save/play/export/restart/rollback and real engine installation remain unaccepted. Runtime resource ceilings are declarations checked statically here, not CPU/RAM/time enforcement.
No archive extraction, general commercial game format support, physical device, production release, paid billing, Wallet mint or external game exchange acceptance.
Single-writer design/index/progress aggregation, fixed-candidate full verify and Git/main acceptance remain separate; GAME-02 requires next exact assignment.
